lines.text: With regard to genital development, which statement is true?
The answer is: the testes and ovaries descend from their original position at the 10th thoracic level. That is the tenth thoracic level.
Both gonads start high up, at the tenth thoracic level, T ten.
The testis and the ovary ride the lift down together. Both descend in embryonic and fetal life.
(laugh) The gubernaculum climbs the rope. This ligamentous cord guides the descent.
Their blood vessels trail down from above. That is why the gonadal arteries take such a long course.
It also explains why pain from the gonads is referred to the umbilicus, the T ten dermatome.
Remember: the testes and ovaries both descend from the tenth thoracic level.
With regard to visual field pathways, which statement is true?
The answer is: the macula region is grossly over-represented in the visual cortex.
This eye is the projector. Rods and cones in the retina turn light into electrical impulses.
The macula is a tiny spot on the retina, the centre of sharp vision.
At the optic chiasm, the fibres cross only partly. Nasal fibres cross, while temporal fibres stay on the same side.
(laugh) But look at the screen. That tiny macula fills almost all of it.
The visual cortex gives the macula far more space than its size.
Remember: the macula is grossly over-represented in the visual cortex.
